verdict.rationale: Radar provides fraud-rate/dispute analytics and risk insights (docs-4, docs-7, docs-19) that let a business observe outcome trends, but there is no evidence of formal precision/recall metrics or a shadow-mode mechanism to trial new rules/models against live traffic before they take over decisions. missing for 10: shadow-mode/A-B testing of new fraud models, explicit precision/recall reporting, side-by-side comparison of rule versions before cutover.
